items.abstract_or_text: Google just open-sourced Harness². (turn any harness into a self-improving system) a harness is everything wrapped around the model, like the system prompt, tools, memory, skills, and subagents. today a person designs it once, and the agent runs every new task with that same fixed setup. Harness² lets the agent refine that setup for each new task on its own, with the model weights left untouched. Google tested this with Gemini 3.5 Flash and GLM-5 on legal, office, and professional work benchmarks. one round of edits was enough to beat their original harnesses.

items.title: DialFork: Going Beyond Factuality to Evaluate Procedural Hallucination in Conversational Agents
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) deployed as conversational agents are increasingly expected to follow procedural logic. While factual hallucination has received extensive attention, a different failure mode has been overlooked: procedural hallucination, in which an agent produces individually fluent and factually plausible utterances while deviating from the intended conversational process. We introduce DialFork, the first benchmark to measure this failure mode on raw dialogue text. DialFork is built by forking conformant dialogues at controlled turn positions and injecting one of four hallucination types, yielding 36,278 dialogues across 24 tasks in 12 domains; 30 human annotators validate the construction. We define three evaluation tasks that characterize procedural deviation at three granularities: how far a set of dialogues deviates from conformant ones (monitoring deployed agents), how far a single dialogue does (procedural retrieval), and at which turn a dialogue first goes off-track (real-time guardrails). For the first two, we propose dialog-flow-aware metrics, FlowKL and FlowScore, that compare dialogues by how they unfold rather than their content. At the dialogue level, FlowScore significantly outperforms all baselines across seven encoders, showing that semantic similarity is no substitute for procedural similarity. We release DialFork under the MIT license at https://github.com/idiap/dialfork, hoping the community will measure conversational process alongside content.
items.summary_zh: 提出 DialFork 基准，通过受控分叉对话构造程序性幻觉，并用 FlowKL、FlowScore 评估对话流程偏离。数据覆盖 24 个任务、12 个领域和 36,278 段对话，FlowScore 在 7 个编码器上优于基线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把代理是否遵循既定程序作为可测任务，提供了清晰的构造、人工验证和多粒度评测；结果可复现性较强，但仍主要针对对话流程而非数学证明。
items.abstract_zh: 部署为对话代理的大语言模型（LLM）越来越需要遵循程序逻辑。尽管事实性幻觉已经受到广泛关注，但另一种失败模式一直被忽视：程序性幻觉，即代理生成的单条话语流畅且在事实层面看似合理，却偏离了预期的对话过程。我们提出 DialFork，这是首个在原始对话文本上衡量这种失败模式的基准。DialFork 在受控的轮次位置分叉符合规范的对话，并注入四种幻觉类型之一，由此生成涵盖 24 个任务、12 个领域的 36,278 段对话；30 名人类标注者对构造进行验证。我们定义了三个评测任务，从三个粒度刻画程序偏离：一组对话偏离符合规范对话的程度（监测已部署的代理）、单段对话偏离的程度（程序检索），以及对话首次偏离轨道的轮次（实时防护）。对于前两个任务，我们提出感知对话流程的指标 FlowKL 和 FlowScore，按对话如何展开而非按内容比较对话。在对话层面，FlowScore 在 7 个编码器上显著优于所有基线，表明语义相似性不能替代程序相似性。我们以 MIT 许可证发布 DialFork，网址为 https://github.com/idiap/dialfork，希望社区在衡量内容的同时也衡量对话过程。

items.title: @AnimaAnandkumar：Can we predict electronic bands beyond DFT across different systems? We introduce O-krystal, a periodic E(3)-equivariant
items.abstract_or_text: Can we predict electronic bands beyond DFT across different systems? We introduce O-krystal, a periodic E(3)-equivariant graph neural network that learns corrections to individual electronic states. It uses orbital information from lower cost PBE calculations in both real and reciprocal space. O-kRystal is the first machine learning framework to combine scale across chemistry (HSE06 band predictions across nearly 6,000 chemically diverse three dimensional materials), breadth across electronic behavior, and flexibility across theory and dimensionality. On a separate benchmark of strongly correlated materials, O-kRystal reduces the PBE band energy MAE by 68.7%.
items.summary_zh: Anima Anandkumar 介绍 O-kRystal：利用低成本 PBE 计算的轨道信息，训练周期性 E(3) 等变图神经网络来校正电子态，并在约 6000 种材料上预测 HSE06 能带。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把超越 DFT 的能带校正扩展到大规模、多样化材料，并报告强关联材料上的明确误差下降，具有 AI for Science 的实质信息。
items.abstract_zh: 我们能否在不同体系中预测超越 DFT 的电子能带？我们提出 O-kRystal，这是一种周期性 E(3) 等变图神经网络，学习对单个电子态的校正。它在实空间和倒空间中都使用低成本 PBE 计算的轨道信息。O-kRystal 是首个同时具备以下特性的机器学习框架：覆盖化学尺度（在近 6000 种化学多样的三维材料上预测 HSE06 能带）、覆盖广泛电子行为，以及适应不同理论和维度。在另一个强关联材料基准上，O-kRystal 将 PBE 能带能量的 MAE 降低了 68.7%。
items.author_line: Prof. Anima Anandkumar

items.title: Scalable Enzyme Reaction Retrieval Enables Metagenomic Biocatalyst Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Enzyme catalyzed reactions drive metabolism and enable diverse applications in biotechnology and sustainable synthesis, but assigning catalytic functions to uncharacterized enzymes and finding enzymes for target reactions remain major challenges. Despite recent advances in machine learning, translating enzyme function prediction into systematic discovery across the vast space of uncharacterized proteins and biochemical reactions remains challenging. Here we present EzHit, a lightweight framework for bidirectional enzyme reaction retrieval. Across enzyme annotation, orphan-reaction retrieval and family-specific fine-tuning benchmarks, EzHit achieved strong top-ranked performance and outperformed representative enzyme reaction matching baselines. We further show that Mahalanobis distance based geometric confidence provides more useful reliability estimates than probability-derived uncertainty metrics or evidential learning, enabling confidence-aware prioritization of high scoring candidates. Owing to its efficiency, EzHit was applied to a nearly trillion-scale OMG_Prot50 with RHEA screen, yielding 8.20 billion retained enzyme reaction associations across 30.27 million predicted enzyme sequences. Experimental validation further confirmed the activity of EzHit prioritized metagenomic enzyme candidates for a sparsely annotated reaction. Together, these results establish EzHit as a scalable framework for enzyme annotation, reaction-guided mining and biocatalyst discovery
items.summary_zh: EzHit 是一个轻量级的双向酶-反应检索框架，用于酶注释、孤儿反应检索和家族特异性微调，并以 Mahalanobis 距离几何置信度筛选大规模宏基因组候选酶；作者还对优先候选进行了活性实验验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把反应检索、置信度估计和超大规模序列筛选连接起来，为宏基因组生物催化剂发现提供了可扩展路径；基准比较、OMG_Prot50 与 RHEA 筛选以及实验验证增强了可信度。摘要未报告具体性能数值，实验验证针对的是一个注释稀疏的反应，且仍是 bioRxiv 预印本。
items.abstract_zh: 酶催化反应驱动代谢并支持生物技术和可持续合成中的多种应用，但为未表征酶分配催化功能以及寻找目标反应所需的酶仍是重大挑战。尽管机器学习近年来取得进展，把酶功能预测转化为覆盖庞大未表征蛋白和生化反应空间的系统发现仍然困难。我们提出 EzHit，一个用于双向酶-反应检索的轻量级框架。在酶注释、孤儿反应检索和家族特异性微调基准中，EzHit 取得了较强的高排名性能，并优于有代表性的酶-反应匹配基线。我们进一步表明，基于 Mahalanobis 距离的几何置信度比基于概率的不确定性指标或证据学习提供更有用的可靠性估计，从而能够按置信度优先处理高分候选。凭借其效率，EzHit 被应用于近万亿规模的 OMG_Prot50 与 RHEA 筛选，保留了 8.20 billion 个酶-反应关联，涉及 30.27 million 条预测酶序列。实验验证进一步确认了 EzHit 为一个注释稀疏反应优先选出的宏基因组酶候选具有活性。综上，这些结果确立了一个可扩展的酶注释、反应引导挖掘和生物催化剂发现框架。

items.title: Beyond Better Models: Barriers and a Path Forward in Generalisable TCR Antigen Specificity Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: T cells are at the centre of adaptive immunity, protecting the organism against infection and cancer. T cell receptors (TCRs), expressed on the surface of T cells, enable the recognition of target cells through interactions with peptides presented by major histocompatibility complex (pMHC) molecules. Reliable, large-scale mapping of TCRs to their cognate pMHCs remains a holy grail of modern systems immunology, with far-reaching implications for cancer immunotherapy, vaccine development, and the understanding and treatment of autoimmune diseases. While exhaustive experimental mapping remains intractable due to the enormous combinatorial sequence space of TCRs and pMHCs, computational approaches offer a promising alternative. Consequently, we have witnessed increasingly sophisticated computational models of TCR antigen specificity, from small neural networks to deep generative models and large protein language models. However, several independent benchmarks have shown that these models, despite their size and sophistication, largely fail to generalise to TCRs or pMHCs not present in the data available during model development. Here, we investigate possible reasons for this and suggest a path forward to generalisable TCR:pMHC prediction. First, our analysis of the largest public repositories of TCR:pMHC data reveals significant biases towards a small number of antigens and MHC molecules, sparse sampling of TCR sequence space per pMHC, as well as inconsistencies and inaccuracies in data collation. Second, we show the importance of carefully setting up model evaluation to measure discrimination based on antigen specificity instead of confounding factors present in the evaluation data. Finally, we highlight the need for and propose how best to match the evaluation metric with the specific downstream application of the predictions. Our investigation suggests that we, as a community, need more representative and better curated data, and a robust set of metrics and benchmarks to guide future model development towards generalisable TCR:pMHC specificity prediction.
items.summary_zh: 该研究系统分析 TCR:pMHC 特异性预测的泛化障碍，指出公开数据集中抗原和 MHC 偏斜、TCR 序列采样稀疏及整理误差，并提出按抗原特异性设定评估和匹配下游任务的指标。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 对数据偏差、混杂因素和评估指标的拆解，为蛋白质相互作用与免疫药物相关模型建立更可靠的基准提供了方法学提醒；分析覆盖大型公开库并用独立基准讨论泛化。它主要是问题诊断和评估路线建议，不是新的预测模型，摘要也未给出前瞻性实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: T 细胞处于适应性免疫的中心，通过感染和癌症保护机体。T 细胞表面的 T 细胞受体（TCR）通过与主要组织相容性复合体（pMHC）分子呈递的肽相互作用，使 T 细胞能够识别靶细胞。可靠、大规模地将 TCR 映射到其对应的 pMHC，仍是现代系统免疫学的一个圣杯，对癌症免疫疗法、疫苗开发以及自身免疫疾病的理解和治疗具有深远影响。由于 TCR 和 pMHC 的组合序列空间极其庞大，穷举式实验映射难以实现，计算方法因此提供了有前景的替代方案。由此，TCR 抗原特异性计算模型不断复杂化，从小型神经网络、深度生成模型发展到大型蛋白质语言模型。然而，多个独立基准表明，尽管这些模型规模更大、技术更复杂，它们在很大程度上仍无法泛化到模型开发数据中未出现的 TCR 或 pMHC。这里，我们研究造成这一问题的可能原因，并提出实现可泛化 TCR:pMHC 预测的前进路径。首先，我们对最大的公开 TCR:pMHC 数据库进行分析，发现其明显偏向少量抗原和 MHC 分子；每个 pMHC 对应的 TCR 序列空间采样稀疏；数据汇编还存在不一致和不准确。其次，我们显示，模型评估需要谨慎设置，以测量基于抗原特异性的区分能力，而不是评估数据中的混杂因素。最后，我们强调并提出，应根据预测的具体下游应用来匹配评估指标。我们的研究表明，整个领域需要更具代表性且整理更好的数据，以及一套稳健的指标和基准，以引导模型开发走向可泛化的 TCR:pMHC 特异性预测。
items.author_line: Koohy, H., Ilievski, I., Antanaviciute, A., Ogg, G.

items.title: Determining cellular phylogeny and migration at high resolution in spatial genomics
items.abstract_or_text: Cellular migration and tumor evolution are central to tissue homeostasis and cancer biology. Rapid advances in spatial genomics have raised the possibility of using somatic mutations to track these processes in situ in human tissues. However, frequent data dropouts in spatial genomics measurements make this challenging to implement. Here, we present StarTrak (SpaTial Analysis for lineage ReconsTRuction with somatic vAriant calling and tracKing), a framework for somatic variant calling and lineage reconstruction at single-pixel spatial resolution. StarTrak employs a neural network framework to integrate mutational evidence (from both nuclear and mitochondrial reads), spatial proximity, histological images, and transcriptomic states to identify spatially informative patterns of mutations. It performs robustly across tissue types and spatial-omics platforms (being particularly successful with spatial ATAC-seq). Applying StarTrak to tumor sections, we infer the migration of mutated tumor cells into adjacent non-malignant tissues and reconstruct distinct lineage trees associated with different spatial regions. Notably, we identify tumor regions with nearly identical transcriptomic states but distinct mutational profiles. Moreover, for skin sections, StarTrak identifies sunlight-associated mutations in non-malignant epidermis and evidence suggesting the migration of these mutant surface cells into deeper skin layers. Overall, by integrating mutation calling with spatial context, StarTrak enables the inference of spatially resolved cellular migration and cellular phylogeny.
items.summary_zh: StarTrak整合体细胞和线粒体突变、空间邻近、组织学图像与转录状态，在单像素分辨率重建细胞谱系和迁移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该神经网络框架跨组织和空间组学平台工作，并在肿瘤和皮肤样本中推断突变细胞的空间迁移。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞迁移和肿瘤演化是组织稳态与癌症生物学的核心过程。空间基因组学的快速发展带来了在人体组织原位利用体细胞突变追踪这些过程的可能性。然而，空间基因组学测量中频繁出现的数据缺失使这一目标难以实现。在此，我们提出StarTrak（SpaTial Analysis for lineage ReconsTRuction with somatic vAriant calling and tracKing），这是一个在单像素空间分辨率上进行体细胞变异检测和谱系重建的框架。StarTrak使用神经网络框架整合来自核和线粒体读段的突变证据、空间邻近性、组织学图像和转录状态，以识别具有空间信息的突变模式。它在不同组织类型和空间组学平台上表现稳健，在空间ATAC-seq上尤其成功。将StarTrak应用于肿瘤切片后，我们推断出突变肿瘤细胞向邻近非恶性组织的迁移，并重建了与不同空间区域相关的独立谱系树。值得注意的是，我们发现一些肿瘤区域具有几乎相同的转录状态，却拥有不同的突变谱。此外，在皮肤切片中，StarTrak识别出非恶性表皮中的日光相关突变，并发现证据提示这些突变的表面细胞迁移到了更深的皮肤层。总体而言，通过将突变检测与空间背景整合，StarTrak实现了空间分辨的细胞迁移和细胞谱系推断。

items.title: AMMPER-2: A spatially explicit agent-based model of microbial radiobiology with redox dye simulation
items.abstract_or_text: To reduce health risks for human space exploration, it is important to model the effects of deep-space radiation on biological systems. The budding yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae is a common model organism in space radiobiology, but little is known about how radiation damage to individual cells translates into the population-level effects that experiments measure. The Agent-Based Model for Microbial Populations Exposed to Radiation (AMMPER) is a spatially explicit agent-based model that simulates the effects of ionizing radiation on S. cerevisiae cells and produces population-level results. Its goal is to improve experiment design and data interpretation. AMMPER-1 demonstrated that agent-based simulations can qualitatively reproduce the effects of proton radiation on the growth rate of wild-type and DNA-repair mutant yeast. Here, we present AMMPER-2, which addresses limitations of the first model and expands its capabilities. AMMPER-2 incorporates the dynamics of the redox dye alamarBlue, a data type commonly generated in spaceflight microbiology experiments, and models the fate of reactive oxygen species in more detail. It also adds an improved graphical interface and runs faster. AMMPER-2 remains easy to execute in Python on a standard personal laptop, providing space biologists a tool to explore experimental conditions, generate hypotheses, and interpret data from microbial space radiation experiments.
items.summary_zh: AMMPER-2是用于模拟深空辐射下酵母群体效应的空间显式Agent-Based Model，加入氧化还原染料和活性氧动力学。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型可在普通笔记本上运行，连接单细胞辐射损伤与群体读数，支持空间生物学实验设计和结果解释。
items.abstract_zh: 为了降低人类太空探索的健康风险，模拟深空辐射对生物系统的影响十分重要。出芽酵母Saccharomyces cerevisiae是空间辐射生物学中常用的模式生物，但人们对单个细胞的辐射损伤如何转化为实验测量的群体效应知之甚少。用于模拟暴露于辐射的微生物群体的Agent-Based Model（AMMPER）是一个空间显式的Agent-Based Model，能够模拟电离辐射对S. cerevisiae细胞的影响并产生群体层面的结果。其目标是改进实验设计和数据解释。AMMPER-1表明，基于Agent的模拟能够定性重现质子辐射对野生型和DNA修复突变酵母生长速率的影响。在此，我们介绍AMMPER-2，它解决了第一代模型的局限并扩展了模型能力。AMMPER-2加入了氧化还原染料alamarBlue的动力学——这是空间飞行微生物学实验中常见的数据类型——并更详细地模拟活性氧的命运。它还增加了改进的图形界面并提高运行速度。AMMPER-2仍然易于在普通个人笔记本上的Python中运行，为空间生物学家探索实验条件、生成假设以及解释微生物空间辐射实验数据提供工具。

items.title: T-cell dysregulation is implicated in the encephalopathy of prematurity
items.abstract_or_text: Preterm birth is strongly linked to systemic inflammation and encephalopathy of prematurity, which underlies subsequent cognitive impairment. T-cell immunity contributes to brain-immune crosstalk across the life course but its role in the pathogenesis of encephalopathy of prematurity is unknown. Protein epigenetic scores are DNA methylation (DNAm)-based proxies of circulating proteins. We tested the hypothesis that T-cell dysregulation has a specific role in child neurodevelopment following preterm birth. Multimodal data were collected from 144 preterm infants (median gestational age at birth 29+5 weeks [range 23+3 to 32+6]) recruited to a prospective cohort study: saliva DNAm for protein epigenetic score derivation and brain MRI, both at term-equivalent age, and the Mullen Scales of Early Learning Composite score at 5 years from a subset. We investigated associations of the epigenetic scores for cytotoxic and regulatory T cell-associated molecule (DNAm CRTAM) and C-reactive protein (DNAm CRP; a non-specific marker of inflammation) with MRI metrics of encephalopathy of prematurity: global and regional brain volumes, and general factors of diffusion tensor imaging and neurite orientation dispersion and density imaging metrics averaged across 42 white matter tracts. We tested whether DNAm CRTAM explains more variance than DNAm CRP in MRI metrics of the encephalopathy of prematurity and cognitive scores in childhood. Higher neonatal DNAm CRTAM was associated with lower general factor of fractional anisotropy ({beta} = -0.252, q = 0.011) and higher general factors of radial diffusivity ({beta} = 0.215, q = 0.039), mean diffusivity ({beta} = 0.198, q = 0.047) and orientation dispersion index ({beta} = 0.201, q = 0.048), independent of inflammatory morbidities and other biological covariates after false discovery rate correction. DNAm CRTAM explained more variance than DNAm CRP (maximum incremental R2 = 4.2% vs 1.5%) in diffusion MRI metrics. Higher neonatal DNAm CRTAM was associated with lower cognitive scores at 5 years, independent of DNAm CRP and other covariates ({beta} = -0.332, P = 0.008), and explained more variance in cognitive scores than DNAm CRP (incremental R2 = 9.4% vs 1.2%). An epigenetic proxy of CRTAM in preterm infants is associated with both encephalopathy of prematurity in the neonatal period and lower cognitive performance at 5 years, explaining greater incremental variance than a non-specific marker of inflammation. The data implicate T-cell dysregulation in the pathophysiology of atypical neurodevelopment following preterm birth.
items.summary_zh: 前瞻性队列研究以DNA甲基化蛋白表观遗传评分、脑MRI和5岁认知结局分析早产儿T细胞失调与脑病的关系。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 样本包含144名早产儿并有纵向认知结局；结果支持相关性证据，不能据此断言T细胞失调造成脑病。
items.abstract_zh: 早产与全身炎症和早产儿脑病密切相关，而早产儿脑病会导致后续认知障碍。T细胞免疫在整个生命过程中参与脑-免疫串扰，但其在早产儿脑病发病机制中的作用尚不清楚。蛋白质表观遗传评分是基于DNA甲基化（DNAm）的循环蛋白代理指标。我们检验了这样一个假设：T细胞失调在早产后儿童神经发育中具有特异性作用。我们从一项前瞻性队列中收集了144名早产儿的多模态数据：在足月等效年龄时采集唾液DNAm以推导蛋白质表观遗传评分并进行脑MRI，在其中一部分儿童5岁时测量Mullen早期学习综合评分。我们研究了细胞毒性和调节性T细胞相关分子（DNAm CRTAM）以及C反应蛋白（DNAm CRP，一种非特异性炎症指标）的表观遗传评分与早产儿脑病MRI指标之间的关系，包括全脑和区域脑体积，以及在42条白质束上取平均的弥散张量成像和神经突定向分散与密度成像指标的一般因子。我们检验了DNAm CRTAM在脑病MRI指标和儿童期认知评分中所解释的方差是否多于DNAm CRP。新生儿DNAm CRTAM较高与较低的一般分数分数各向异性（β = -0.252，q = 0.011）以及较高的一般径向弥散率（β = 0.215，q = 0.039）、平均弥散率（β = 0.198，q = 0.047）和定向分散指数（β = 0.201，q = 0.048）相关；在错误发现率校正后，这些关系独立于炎症性疾病和其他生物学协变量。与DNAm CRP相比，DNAm CRTAM解释了更多弥散MRI指标的方差（最大增量R2 = 4.2% 对 1.5%）。新生儿DNAm CRTAM较高与5岁时较低的认知评分相关，在控制DNAm CRP和其他协变量后仍然成立（β = -0.332，P = 0.008），并且比DNAm CRP解释了更多认知评分方差（增量R2 = 9.4% 对 1.2%）。早产儿中CRTAM的表观遗传代理指标与新生儿期的早产儿脑病和5岁时较低的认知表现均相关，且解释的增量方差大于非特异性炎症指标。这些数据表明，T细胞失调参与非典型神经发育的病理生理过程。

items.title: Neural signatures of glioma progression using implanted neural interfaces
items.abstract_or_text: High-grade glioma is an incurable brain cancer with a median survival of approximately 14 months. Over the last 50 years, small improvements in patient outcomes have been overshadowed by significant progress in most other cancers. Yet, emerging research has revealed that neural circuits play an active and central role in driving glioma growth and proliferation, highlighting the nervous system as a promising avenue for both disease monitoring and therapeutic intervention. Here, we present a platform for chronically monitoring tumor progression using neural recordings in freely behaving mice with gliomas. Using this platform across multiple mouse strains and glioma models, we show that neural recordings can accurately track tumor progression in vivo. Cancer progression was consistently associated with elevated gamma-band neural activity in the tumor microenvironment across both adult glioblastoma (GBM) and pediatric diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma (DIPG) cancer models. Interestingly, lower frequency neural activity exhibited distinct, cell-line specific changes over time: GBM models exhibited decreases in low frequency neural activity whereas DIPG models exhibited increases over time. Finally, using machine learning models applied to chronic neural recordings from tumor-bearing mice treated with or without standard-of-care chemotherapy (temozolomide for GBM), we accurately predicted tumor burden as inferred through in vivo bioluminescence imaging. By fitting low-dimensional mathematical models to gamma-band neural trajectories, we could further predict individual tumor growth rates over a 5-week period with high accuracy. These results establish that pathological neural-tumor interactions can be harnessed to monitor glioma progression in vivo. Coupling this monitoring capability with therapeutic electrical stimulation in the same device could open up a new class of implantable, closed-loop neurotechnologies with the potential to transform glioma treatment.
items.summary_zh: 植入式神经接口结合神经记录和机器学习，在多种小鼠胶质瘤模型中追踪肿瘤进展并预测肿瘤负荷。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究将神经-肿瘤信号、体内生物发光和治疗状态结合，展示闭环神经技术监测胶质瘤的潜力，但证据仍来自小鼠。
items.abstract_zh: 高级别胶质瘤是一种无法治愈的脑癌，中位生存期约为14个月。在过去50年中，患者结局仅有小幅改善，而其他大多数癌症却取得了显著进展。然而，越来越多的研究显示，神经回路在驱动胶质瘤生长和增殖方面发挥主动且核心的作用，提示神经系统可能成为疾病监测和治疗干预的有前景方向。在此，我们提出一种平台，用于在自由活动的胶质瘤小鼠中长期监测肿瘤进展。利用该平台，并覆盖多个小鼠品系和胶质瘤模型，我们显示神经记录能够在体内准确追踪肿瘤进展。在成人胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）和儿童弥漫性内生性脑桥胶质瘤（DIPG）模型中，癌症进展始终与肿瘤微环境中升高的γ频段神经活动相关。有趣的是，低频神经活动随时间呈现细胞系特异性变化：GBM模型中的低频活动下降，而DIPG模型中的低频活动随时间增加。最后，将机器学习模型应用于长期神经记录（这些记录来自接受或未接受标准护理化疗的荷瘤小鼠；GBM使用temozolomide），我们能够准确预测由体内生物发光成像推断的肿瘤负荷。通过对γ频段轨迹拟合低维数学模型，我们还能够高精度预测单个肿瘤在5周内的生长速率。这些结果表明，可以利用病理性神经-肿瘤相互作用来在体内监测胶质瘤。将这种监测能力与同一设备中的治疗性电刺激结合，有望开启一类新的植入式闭环神经技术，并可能改变胶质瘤治疗。

items.title: Temporal multi-omics dataset of a cucurbit–powdery mildew interaction
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Plant-pathogenic fungi are major contributors to global crop losses, yet many of the most damaging groups, especially obligate biotrophs, remain difficult to study. Their strict dependence on living host tissue limits experimental manipulation and has constrained the generation of comprehensive datasets that capture how these pathogens suppress host immunity and reprogram metabolism over time. To expand the resources available for data-driven research, we present a temporally resolved multi-omics dataset characterizing the interaction between Cucumis melo and Podosphaera xanthii , the causal agent of cucurbit powdery mildew and a model obligate biotroph. Inoculated and mock-treated melon leaves were sampled across 12 time points from 12 to 144 hours post inoculation, covering key developmental transitions of the pathogen. The dataset integrates dual RNA-seq and untargeted LC–MS/MS metabolomics generated from the same biological material, accompanied by detailed documentation of experimental design, bioinformatic workflows, quality-control metrics and processed outputs to ensure broad reusability. This resource enables exploration of host–pathogen transcriptional dynamics, stage-specific infection responses, metabolic remodeling and integrative multi-omics analyses of obligate biotrophy.
items.summary_zh: 发布Cucumis melo–Podosphaera xanthii互作的时间分辨双RNA-seq与非靶向LC–MS/MS多组学数据集。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同一生物材料覆盖12个接种后时间点，配有实验设计、质控和处理流程文档，适合宿主-病原体动态与可复用分析。
items.abstract_zh: 植物病原真菌是全球作物损失的重要原因，但许多危害最大的类群，尤其是专性活体营养型病原体，仍然难以研究。它们严格依赖活体宿主组织，限制了实验操作，也阻碍了生成能够描述这些病原体如何随时间抑制宿主免疫和重编程代谢的综合数据集。为扩展数据驱动研究可用的资源，我们提供了一个时间分辨的多组学数据集，用于刻画Cucumis melo与Podosphaera xanthii之间的互作；后者是瓜类白粉病的致病因，也是专性活体营养型病原体的模式。接种和模拟处理的甜瓜叶片在接种后12至144小时的12个时间点取样，覆盖病原体发育的关键转换阶段。该数据集整合了来自同一生物材料的双RNA-seq和非靶向LC–MS/MS代谢组学，并配有详细的实验设计、生物信息学流程、质量控制指标和处理后输出文档，以确保广泛复用。该资源可用于研究宿主-病原体转录动态、阶段特异性侵染反应、代谢重塑以及专性活体营养的整合多组学分析。
items.author_line: Jiménez-Sánchez A, Fernández-Ortuño D, Pastor V, Polonio Á, Pérez-García A

items.title: Lipid nanoparticle-mediated RNAi targeting of KRAS mutants sensitises colorectal cancer cells to chemotherapy
items.abstract_or_text: KRAS mutations, including G12D, G12V and G13D, are major oncogenic drivers in colorectal cancer (CRC) and are associated with therapeutic resistance. However, approved KRAS inhibitors remain focused on G12C subtype, leaving these prevalent variants without approved targeted therapies. Here, we developed a lipid nanoparticle (LNP)-based RNA interference (RNAi) strategy to target these three KRAS variants using a single small interfering RNA (siRNA) sequence. The developed siRNA-LNPs reduced KRAS mRNA and protein expression in HCT116 (G13D), SW620 (G12V) and LS180 (G12D) cells, but not in KRAS wild-type HT29 cells, suppressing the cellular proliferation, clonogenic survival and migration. Transcriptomic profiling revealed changes in KRAS associated signalling, including suppression of cell-cycle and DNA repair programmes, providing a rationale for combining siRNA silencing with the fluoropyrimidine chemotherapeutic agent 5-fluorouracil (5-FU). The combination produced synergistic effects across all three KRAS-mutant CRC cell models and enhanced the apoptosis in both monolayer cultures and 3D spheroids. Collectively, these findings provide proof of concept for this combination strategy and support its further investigation as a potential therapeutic approach for KRAS-mutant CRC.

items.abstract_zh: KRAS突变，包括G12D、G12V和G13D，是结直肠癌（CRC）的主要致癌驱动因素，并与治疗耐药相关。然而，获批的KRAS抑制剂仍主要针对G12C亚型，使这些常见变体缺乏获批的靶向治疗。我们开发了一种基于脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）的RNA干扰（RNAi）策略，使用单条小干扰RNA（siRNA）序列靶向这三种KRAS变体。所开发的siRNA-LNP降低了HCT116（G13D）、SW620（G12V）和LS180（G12D）细胞中的KRAS mRNA和蛋白表达，但在KRAS野生型HT29细胞中没有这一作用，并抑制了细胞增殖、克隆存活和迁移。转录组分析显示KRAS相关信号发生变化，包括细胞周期和DNA修复程序受到抑制，这为将siRNA沉默与氟嘧啶类化疗药物5-fluorouracil（5-FU）联合提供了依据。在三种KRAS突变CRC细胞模型中，该联合方案均产生协同效应，并在单层培养和3D球体中增强凋亡。总体而言，这些结果为该联合策略提供了概念验证，并支持进一步研究其作为KRAS突变CRC潜在治疗方案的可行性。

items.title: When do quantum views help? Complementary classical-quantum representations in multi-view fusion
items.abstract_or_text: Recent studies have reported promising results from quantum machine learning in drug discovery, healthcare, materials science and cybersecurity. Research includes comparisons with classical machine learning algorithms and the development of sequential hybrid pipelines. We propose that fusion can improve prediction when classical and quantum representations capture complementary predictive relationships. Our classical-quantum multi-view framework preserves the full classical input alongside simulated quantum features. Concatenation and attention combine the views; single-view comparisons, replacement and masking controls assess both views' contributions. Controlled angular-polynomial experiments distinguish targets adequately represented by a single view from those that depend on complementary angular and polynomial relationships. For these mixed targets, fusion improves prediction by combining the relevant feature sets, while matched classical representations recover the same benefit, linking the improvement to their complementary predictive content. Controlled classification tests further show that gains depend on alignment between the chosen representation and the target, and on a suitable fusion rule. Benchmark validation shows improved mean predictive performance over classical baselines on Wine, Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer, three-class Fashion-MNIST and Steel Plates Faults within the evaluated protocols. Classical replacement and masking controls remain competitive, classical baselines lead on Digits and Covertype, and outcomes with missing or corrupted views depend on the available inputs. These findings support evaluating quantum representations for their complementary predictive contribution and matching the representation and fusion strategy to the target relationships.
items.summary_zh: 该工作提出保留完整经典输入并融合模拟量子特征的多视图框架，用单视图、替换和掩码对照检验量子表征的增益来源；结果表明，增益取决于表征与目标关系的互补性及融合规则。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它用匹配的经典替代表明所谓量子增益可能来自互补信息而非量子表征本身，为药物发现和材料建模中的量子机器学习评估提供了更严格的对照思路。验证数据主要是 Wine、Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer、Fashion-MNIST 和 Steel Plates Faults 等通用基准，使用模拟量子特征；在 Digits 和 Covertype 上经典基线领先，尚未显示化学数据上的直接优势。
items.abstract_zh: 近期研究在药物发现、医疗保健、材料科学和网络安全中报告了量子机器学习的良好结果。这些研究包括与经典机器学习算法的比较，以及顺序式混合流水线的开发。我们提出，当经典表征和量子表征捕获互补的预测关系时，融合可以改善预测。我们的经典-量子多视图框架保留完整的经典输入，同时加入模拟量子特征。我们通过拼接和注意力融合这些视图；通过单视图比较、替换和掩码对照评估两个视图各自的贡献。受控的角度-多项式实验区分了由单一视图充分表示的目标，以及依赖互补角度和多项式关系的目标。对于这些混合目标，融合通过组合相关特征集改善预测，而匹配的经典表征可以恢复相同的收益，这把改进归因于其互补的预测内容。受控分类测试进一步表明，增益取决于所选表征与目标之间的匹配，以及合适的融合规则。在所评估的协议内，基准验证显示，与经典基线相比，Wine、Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer、三分类 Fashion-MNIST 和 Steel Plates Faults 的平均预测性能有所提高。经典替换和掩码对照仍具有竞争力；在 Digits 和 Covertype 上，经典基线领先；当视图缺失或损坏时，结果取决于可用输入。这些发现支持根据量子表征的互补预测贡献来评估它们，并使表征和融合策略匹配目标关系。

items.title: A systematic investigation of molecular encoding methods for drug property predictions across neural network and Transformer encoder-based model
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Fundamental investigations into how different molecular encoding methods affect molecular property prediction remain relatively limited. In this study, we extensively examined the optimal molecular encoding methods for molecular properties prediction using two prevalent structure designs: neural network model (MLP) and a Transformer encoder-based model (MLP + TL). For molecular encoding methods, we investigated several types of fingerprints, including traditional topological fingerprints, substructure-based fingerprints, and string-based representations. These two models were trained on seven well-known molecular datasets to evaluate different input molecular encoding methods based on evaluation metrics. On several biologically relevant classification tasks, including toxicity, mutagenicity, and side-effect prediction, our models consistently achieved average AUC values above 0.9. Beyond model performance, we further explored whether the Transformer encoder-based framework could provide interpretable insight. Rather than relying on external post-hoc explanation methods such as the local interpretable model-agnostic explanation (LIME) or the Deep SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP), we leveraged the model’s intrinsic attention weights as an internal interpretability signal for identifying potentially important feature. To further support this analysis, we conducted case studies on the BBBP and MUTAG datasets. The MLP + TL model using MACCS and PubChem as input can capture chemically interpretable groups that determined the major blood-brain barrier (BBB) permeability and mutagenicity in Salmonella typhimurium . In particular, a comparison between Morphine and Heroin highlighted the role of hydroxyl-related substructures in BBB permeability prediction, which was consistently reflected in the attention weights. Overall, our findings provide practical guidance for selecting effective molecular encoding methods and contribute to the development of interpretable molecular informatics approaches for drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: 系统比较多种分子编码在神经网络和Transformer模型药物性质预测中的作用，并分析内在注意力可解释性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 覆盖7个分子数据集和毒性、致突变性、侧作用等任务，为分子表示选择及化学解释提供了可操作证据。
items.abstract_zh: 关于不同分子编码方法如何影响分子性质预测的基础研究仍相对有限。在本研究中，我们使用两种常见的结构设计——神经网络模型（MLP）和基于Transformer编码器的模型（MLP + TL）——系统考察分子性质预测的最佳分子编码方法。对于分子编码方法，我们研究了多种指纹，包括传统拓扑指纹、基于子结构的指纹和基于字符串的表示。这两种模型在7个广为人知的分子数据集上进行训练，以基于评估指标比较不同输入分子编码方法。在包括毒性、致突变性和副作用预测在内的多个生物学相关分类任务中，我们的模型持续取得超过0.9的平均AUC。除模型性能外，我们还进一步探索基于Transformer编码器的框架是否能够提供可解释的洞见。我们没有依赖LIME或Deep SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）等外部事后解释方法，而是利用模型内在的注意力权重作为内部可解释性信号，以识别潜在重要特征。为进一步支持这一分析，我们在BBBP和MUTAG数据集上开展了案例研究。使用MACCS和PubChem作为输入的MLP + TL模型能够捕获决定血脑屏障（BBB）通透性和Salmonella typhimurium致突变性的、具有化学可解释性的基团。特别是，Morphine和Heroin的比较突出了羟基相关子结构在BBB通透性预测中的作用，而这一点在注意力权重中得到了稳定反映。总体而言，我们的研究为选择有效的分子编码提供了实践指导，并促进了可解释分子信息学方法在药物发现中的发展。

items.title: Investigating the Ligandin Activity of Schistosoma mansoni Glutathione S-Transferases Toward Testosterone: Implications for Novel Anthelminthic Drug Target Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Schistosomiasis is one of the most common neglected tropical diseases globally, with more than 250 million people affected, and praziquantel is the only broadly available chemotherapeutic agent. However, concerns regarding decreased susceptibility to the drug and the lack of alternative therapies underscore the need to identify new therapeutic targets. Glutathione S -transferases (GSTs) are enzymes with diverse biological functions, including parasite detoxification, antioxidant defense, and ligand transport. This study investigated the interaction of 26- and 28-kDa GST isoforms from Schistosoma species with testosterone, which was evaluated as a potential anthelmintic. Testosterone did not exhibit acute vermicidal activity, as adult Schistosoma mansoni worms remained motile after 60 min, whereas praziquantel caused immediate complete immobilization. Homology models of S. mansoni Sm 26GST and Sm 28GST were validated by Ramachandran analysis and showed conserved catalytic cores with variable substrate-binding loops. Recombinant Sj 26GST and Sh 28GST were successfully overexpressed and purified. Both enzymes were inhibited by testosterone in a concentration-dependent manner, with IC₅₀ values of 0.63 mM and 0.73 mM, respectively. Far-UV Circular dichroism and extrinsic ANS fluorescence spectroscopy confirmed the conformational changes caused by the ligands. Induced-fit docking showed that the binding pocket is conserved at the GST dimer interface, and the 500-ns molecular dynamics simulations showed that the complexes were more stable than the apo proteins, with Sm 28GST being more rigid. Testosterone analogues were identified by high-throughput virtual screening that predicted binding affinities higher than those of testosterone. The results suggest that schistosome GSTs are promising targets for structure-based drug discovery against schistosomes.
items.summary_zh: 结合结构建模、生化实验、对接和分子动力学，研究Schistosoma mansoni GST与testosterone的配体活性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对影响超过2.5亿人的血吸虫病，提出GST作为结构基础抗血吸虫药物发现靶点，但目前证据仍主要来自体外和计算分析。
items.abstract_zh: 血吸虫病是全球最常见的被忽视热带病之一，影响超过2.5亿人，而praziquantel是唯一广泛可用的化学治疗药物。然而，人们担心对该药的敏感性下降且缺乏替代疗法，因此有必要确定新的治疗靶点。谷胱甘肽S-转移酶（GST）具有多种生物学功能，包括寄生虫解毒、抗氧化防御和配体转运。本研究考察了Schistosoma物种的26-kDa和28-kDa GST亚型与testosterone的相互作用，并将testosterone作为潜在抗血吸虫药物进行评估。testosterone没有表现出急性杀虫活性：成年Schistosoma mansoni蠕虫在60分钟后仍保持运动，而praziquantel会立即使其完全失去活动能力。S. mansoni Sm 26GST和Sm 28GST的同源性模型通过Ramachandran分析进行了验证，显示出保守的催化核心和可变的底物结合环。重组Sj 26GST和Sh 28GST成功过表达并纯化。两种酶均受到testosterone浓度依赖性的抑制，IC₅₀分别为0.63 mM和0.73 mM。远紫外圆二色谱和外源ANS荧光光谱证实了配体引起的构象变化。诱导契合对接显示，结合口袋在GST二聚体界面处是保守的；500-ns分子动力学模拟显示，复合物比脱辅基蛋白更稳定，其中Sm 28GST的刚性更高。通过高通量虚拟筛选鉴定出预测结合亲和力高于testosterone的testosterone类似物。结果表明，血吸虫GST是针对血吸虫进行结构基础药物发现的有前景靶点。

items.title: AgentPerturb: Evaluating LLM Agent Robustness under Controlled Interaction Perturbations
items.abstract_or_text: Real-world tasks are often complex and noisy, posing substantial challenges for LLM agents. Yet existing evaluations lack a systematic framework for jointly characterizing potential perturbation targets and types. We use this two-dimensional view to conduct a unified study that quantifies the robustness of current frontier models, traces the mechanisms behind perturbation-induced failures, and draws implications for robustness-oriented training. Through controlled evaluations on APEX-Agents and Toolathlon, we find that perturbations consistently degrade performance, while the dominant vulnerabilities vary across task environments. Trajectory-level analysis reveals that agents rarely recognize altered inputs and often propagate corrupted information without verification. A focused cost analysis further shows that successful perturbed trajectories can require substantially more computation. These findings motivate training objectives that cover diverse forms of noise and reward verification, uncertainty awareness, and recovery. We provide a rigorous benchmark-construction pipeline. Code and data will be released at https://github.com/xuyj233/AgentPerturb.
items.summary_zh: 提出 AgentPerturb，用二维扰动框架系统评估 LLM 代理在 APEX-Agents 和 Toolathlon 中的鲁棒性，并分析扰动导致的失败机制与计算成本。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 任务、扰动类型和轨迹分析定义较清楚，能检验代理是否识别并恢复被篡改的信息；摘要报告了跨环境的一致退化，但未给出完整的绝对性能表。
items.abstract_zh: 现实世界的任务通常复杂且带有噪声，这给 LLM 代理带来了重大挑战。然而，现有评测缺少一个能联合刻画潜在扰动目标与扰动类型的系统框架。我们采用这种二维视角开展统一研究，量化当前前沿模型的鲁棒性，追踪扰动诱发失败的机制，并提出对面向鲁棒性训练的启示。通过在 APEX-Agents 和 Toolathlon 上进行受控评测，我们发现扰动会持续降低性能，而主要脆弱点随任务环境而变化。轨迹层面的分析显示，代理很少识别输入已被改变，并且经常未经核验就传播被污染的信息。针对成本的分析进一步表明，成功完成受扰动任务的轨迹可能需要显著更多的计算。上述发现支持这样的训练目标：覆盖多种噪声形式，并奖励核验、不确定性感知和恢复能力。我们提供了严格的基准构建流程。代码和数据将发布于 https://github.com/xuyj233/AgentPerturb。

items.title: SciΠvot: Benchmarking Principal-Investigator Judgment at Pivotal Moments of Scientific AutoResearch Agents
items.abstract_or_text: Large language model (LLM) agents can keep scientific experiments running for months with little human supervision, but reliable autonomous research also requires scientific judgment. Evaluating scientific judgment is difficult because research decisions are open-ended and depend on project context. We construct SciΠvot, a 248-case benchmark of scientific judgment based on human corrections. The benchmark draws on records from six months of research in which senior researchers ran LLM agents on 26 projects across six scientific fields and repeatedly intervened to correct the agents' research judgments. In each case, an agent chooses between the original LLM plan and the human-corrected alternative, using only the project record available before the correction as context. We compare LLM and human performance and examine the effects of reasoning effort, access to the project record, and reconsideration. At medium reasoning effort with the project record, models systematically prefer the original LLM plan over the human-corrected alternative. Four of five frontier models perform below chance on the selected cases. The highest accuracy in the project condition across the tested models and reasoning effort settings is 63.5%, compared with 73.4% for fresh researchers. At medium effort, every model achieves lower accuracy with the project record than without it, and reconsideration does not consistently improve overall accuracy. Even with a human-corrected alternative available, frontier models struggle with the selected research decisions, while SciΠvot supports systematic evaluation of scientific judgment for LLM agents.
items.summary_zh: 构建 SciΠvot 科学判断基准，从 26 个项目、6 个科学领域和 6 个月的代理研究记录中提取 248 个由资深研究者纠正的决策案例，并比较模型与研究人员的判断。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把开放式科研判断转化为二选一、可复核的评测任务，报告了模型在项目上下文中低于随机水平的结果；它衡量的是科研判断，不能直接等同于数学证明能力。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）代理可以在很少人工监督的情况下让科学实验持续数月，但可靠的自主研究还需要科学判断。评估科学判断很困难，因为研究决策是开放式的，并且取决于项目背景。我们构建了 SciΠvot，这是一个包含 248 个案例的科学判断基准，基于人类纠正构建。该基准取材于 6 个月的研究记录；在这段时间里，资深研究人员让 LLM 代理运行于 6 个科学领域的 26 个项目，并反复介入纠正代理的研究判断。在每个案例中，代理只能使用纠正发生前可获得的项目记录作为上下文，在原始 LLM 计划与人类纠正后的替代方案之间进行选择。我们比较 LLM 与人类的表现，并考察推理强度、是否能访问项目记录以及重新考虑决策的影响。在中等推理强度且提供项目记录时，模型系统性地偏好原始 LLM 计划，而不是人类纠正后的替代方案。在所选案例上，5 个前沿模型中的 4 个表现低于随机水平。在测试的模型和推理强度设置中，项目条件下的最高准确率为 63.5%，而新参与研究的人员为 73.4%。在中等强度下，每个模型在有项目记录时的准确率都低于没有项目记录时，重新考虑也没有稳定地提升总体准确率。即使提供了人类纠正后的替代方案，前沿模型仍难以处理所选研究决策，而 SciΠvot 支持对 LLM 代理的科学判断进行系统评估。

items.title: LigRNA: High-accuracy prediction of RNA-ligand binding sites via dynamic chemical complementarity and language model encoding
items.abstract_or_text: RNA-binding small molecules represent a validated therapeutic modality, yet pinpointing their exact RNA binding sites remains critical for mechanistic understanding and drug optimization. Experimental methods, while precise, are costly and low-throughput, necessitating robust computational alternatives. Approaches based on static feature concatenation may overlook input-dependent relationships between RNA residues and ligand functional groups. Here we present LigRNA, a graph neural network framework that predicts RNA-ligand binding sites through joint cross-modal encoding of both molecules. LigRNA integrates structure-guided language model embeddings with physicochemical features-solvent-accessible surface area and secondary structure types, to construct comprehensive RNA representations. Ligands are encoded as attributed molecular graphs via graph attention networks, preserving atom-level chemical topology rather than compressing molecules into fixed fingerprints. A cross-attention mechanism then enables dynamic, ligand-dependent modulation of RNA nucleotide attention, capturing context-specific interaction patterns. Benchmarked on TE9 and TE18 datasets, LigRNA achieves F1 scores of 0.73 and 0.58, improving on GATRsite by 7.4% and 18.4%, respectively. Ablation studies identify the RNA residual encoder as the most consistent contributor across the two benchmarks. The source code is freely available at https://github.com/WillowWang0216/LigRNA.
items.summary_zh: LigRNA 通过结构引导的语言模型嵌入、RNA 物理化学特征、配体分子图和跨注意力联合预测 RNA-配体结合位点，在 TE9 和 TE18 数据集上优于 GATRsite。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该框架把配体原子级化学拓扑与依赖配体的 RNA 位点注意力结合，适合支持 RNA 靶向小分子的机制分析和优化；TE9/TE18 基准及消融研究提供了可核查的模型证据。摘要所示验证集中于两个数据集，尚未说明独立实验位点验证，且这是 bioRxiv 预印本。
items.abstract_zh: RNA 结合小分子已成为一种经过验证的治疗方式，但精准确定其 RNA 结合位点对于机制理解和药物优化仍至关重要。实验方法虽精确，却成本高且通量低，因此需要稳健的计算替代方案。基于静态特征拼接的方法可能忽略 RNA 残基与配体官能团之间依赖输入的关系。我们提出 LigRNA，一种通过对两种分子进行联合跨模态编码来预测 RNA-配体结合位点的图神经网络框架。LigRNA 将结构引导的语言模型嵌入与物理化学特征-溶剂可及表面积和二级结构类型-结合起来，构建综合 RNA 表征。配体通过图注意力网络编码为带属性的分子图，保留原子级化学拓扑，而不是将分子压缩为固定指纹。随后，交叉注意力机制对 RNA 核苷酸注意力进行依赖配体的动态调制，以捕获特定上下文的相互作用模式。在 TE9 和 TE18 数据集上进行基准测试时，LigRNA 的 F1 分数分别为 0.73 和 0.58，相比 GATRsite 分别提高 7.4% 和 18.4%。消融研究表明，RNA residual encoder 在两个基准上都是贡献最稳定的组成部分。源代码可从 https://github.com/WillowWang0216/LigRNA 免费获取。

items.title: PATHNet: A Thermodynamic Path-Integral-Inspired Neural Network for Protein-Ligand Interaction Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Protein-ligand scoring functions must capture strongly nonlinear, target-dependent binding physics while remaining generalizable beyond their training data, a balance that purely analytic and purely data-driven models each struggle to achieve on their own. We present PATHNet, a physics-informed framework that learns this unknown functional relationship from molecular-mechanics descriptors using a non-monotonic piecewise-linear mapper with a bounded neural-network correction, trained through a variational, least-action-inspired objective and regulated by a renormalization-group-inspired spectral constraint, with model selection performed through multi-start basin optimization. Across seven DUD-E targets, PATHNet achieved the highest mean active inactive/decoy classification accuracy among the methods tested, outperforming three literature baselines representing distinct architectural families. These results support a physics-grounded, variationally constrained approach to neural-network scoring as a practical route toward more interpretable and transferable protein-ligand interaction models.
items.summary_zh: PATHNet 从分子力学描述符学习蛋白质-配体打分函数，引入非单调分段线性映射、受界定的神经网络修正、变分最小作用量式目标和重整化群式谱约束，并在七个 DUD-E 靶点上与三类基线比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它尝试把结合物理、变分训练和谱约束结合起来，在蛋白质-配体活性/诱饵分类上取得所测方法中的最高平均准确率，为更可解释、可迁移的打分模型提供了方向。证据目前只来自七个 DUD-E 靶点的离线分类，摘要未给出独立测试或实验结合验证，且为 bioRxiv 预印本。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质-配体打分函数必须捕捉强非线性、依赖靶点的结合物理，同时还要在训练数据之外保持可泛化性；纯解析方法和纯数据驱动模型各自都难以兼顾这两点。我们提出 PATHNet，一个物理信息框架：它从分子力学描述符学习这一未知函数关系，使用带有有界神经网络修正的非单调分段线性映射，通过受变分最小作用量启发的目标进行训练，并以受重整化群启发的谱约束加以调节；模型选择采用多起点 basin optimization。在七个 DUD-E 靶点上，PATHNet 在所测试方法中的活性物/非活性诱饵分类平均准确率最高，超过了代表不同架构家族的三种文献基线。这些结果支持一种以物理为基础、受变分约束的神经网络打分方法，将其作为构建更具可解释性和可迁移性的蛋白质-配体相互作用模型的实用途径。
items.author_line: A. S., B. G., Singh, A., Kanchan, S., Kulkarni, N. M.

items.title: Complex enzyme active site scaffolding by iteratively detuned catalytic guidance
items.abstract_or_text: De novo enzyme design requires sequences whose structures reproduce prescribed catalytic geometries. This remains challenging for active sites that couple multiple catalytic residues, cofactors and substrates. Here we introduce the Catalytic Guidance Engine (CaGE), which optimizes designed sequences to satisfy complex sets of functional constraints by alternating constraint guided structure prediction trajectories with sequence design, gradually fading the strength of the constraint information over cycles to nudge the designed sequence towards satisfying all the constraints. We train RF3 to accept atom-pair distances and other design conditions, and use classifier-free guidance to fade their influence over multiple design cycles. We also develop training-free motif guidance protocols which operate at inference time by directly adjusting selected atoms towards the design target geometry during diffusion sampling. CaGE improves catalytic-motif geometry across a diverse enzyme benchmark and yields sequences that recover complex target active sites in independent AF3 predictions. We experimentally demonstrate the power of CaGE by designing active enzymes with complex catalytic sites: a nonheme-iron design positions four active-site residues around an iron centre and a transition-state ligand, and a PLP-dependent design positions four catalytic residues around a PLP cofactor with multiple functional groups. Active site substitutions and a 2.7[A] crystal structure support the designed mechanisms and structures. Thus, CaGE provides a route to functional de novo enzymes with complex active sites.
items.summary_zh: CaGE 交替进行约束引导的结构预测和序列设计，并逐轮减弱约束；它通过 RF3、classifier-free guidance 和无需训练的 motif guidance 设计复杂酶活性位点，并以独立 AF3 预测、活性位点替换和 2.7[A] 晶体结构支持设计机制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法把扩散式结构生成、序列优化和催化几何约束结合起来，并在 nonheme-iron 与 PLP-dependent 两类酶设计中获得实验和结构证据，是本批候选中验证强度较高的从头酶设计工作。摘要只展示了有限的设计案例，且为 bioRxiv 预印本，具体催化活性指标仍需查看全文。
items.abstract_zh: 从头酶设计需要得到结构能够重现指定催化几何的序列。对于耦合多个催化残基、辅因子和底物的活性位点，这仍然具有挑战性。我们提出 Catalytic Guidance Engine（CaGE），通过交替进行约束引导的结构预测轨迹和序列设计来优化设计序列，以满足复杂的功能约束；在多个循环中逐渐减弱约束信息的强度，推动设计序列满足全部约束。我们训练 RF3 接受原子对距离和其他设计条件，并使用 classifier-free guidance 在多个设计循环中逐渐减弱这些条件的影响。我们还开发了无需训练的 motif guidance 协议，在推理时通过在扩散采样期间直接将选定原子调整到目标几何来发挥作用。CaGE 在多样化的酶基准上改善了催化 motif 的几何结构，并产生了能在独立 AF3 预测中恢复复杂目标活性位点的序列。我们通过设计具有复杂催化位点的活性酶对 CaGE 的能力进行了实验验证：一个 nonheme-iron 设计将四个活性位点残基定位在铁中心和一个 transition-state ligand 周围；一个 PLP-dependent 设计将四个催化残基定位在具有多个官能团的 PLP 辅因子周围。活性位点替换实验和 2.7[A] 晶体结构支持所设计的机制和结构。因此，CaGE 为具有复杂活性位点的功能性从头酶设计提供了一条路径。

items.title: RGI-Toolkit: Differentiable Restraints for Controllable Biomolecular Structure Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Diffusion-based models have substantially advanced biomolecular structure prediction. Within this framework, restraint-guided inference (RGI) corrects the denoiser output at each reverse-diffusion step using a differentiable restraint loss, allowing available experimental information, stereochemical requirements, or a specified target conformational state to be incorporated into predictions without retraining the model. Here, we present RGI-Toolkit, a general-purpose Python library that makes RGI available for a range of structure predictors. The toolkit consolidates restraint definition, atom selection, loss evaluation, and coordinate optimization into a shared, backend-agnostic engine, limiting predictor-specific code to a thin preprocessing adapter and a single hook in the denoising loop. Restraints on distances, angles, and dihedrals, on deviations from reference structures, and on user-defined reaction coordinates, together with ligand conformer restraints, are all specified in a common configuration format. The toolkit currently supports six predictors, including AlphaFold3. Across all six predictors, conformer restraints eliminated chirality and cis/trans errors in the predicted ligands and improved their local geometry, while geometric and custom restraints systematically shifted the sampled protein conformations toward the specified target states. RGI-Toolkit thus provides a unified framework for integrating experimental information and prior geometric knowledge into structure prediction and for generating biomolecular structures with specified conformational and stereochemical properties.
items.summary_zh: RGI-Toolkit 将可微约束引导推理封装为通用 Python 库，把距离、角度、二面角、参考结构偏差、反应坐标和配体构象约束接入六种结构预测器，包括 AlphaFold3。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它提供了后端无关的结构控制接口，可把实验信息、立体化学要求和目标构象整合进扩散式预测，而无需重新训练；在六种预测器上，构象约束消除了预测配体的 chirality 与 cis/trans 错误并改善局部几何。摘要未给出详细定量指标，结果主要是结构预测评估，且该条目属于 bioRxiv 修订预印本。
items.abstract_zh: 基于扩散的模型显著推进了生物分子结构预测。在这一框架中，约束引导推理（RGI）在每个反向扩散步骤中使用可微约束损失校正去噪器输出，使可用的实验信息、立体化学要求或指定的目标构象状态能够被纳入预测，而无需重新训练模型。我们提出 RGI-Toolkit，这是一个通用 Python 库，使 RGI 可用于一系列结构预测器。该工具包将约束定义、原子选择、损失评估和坐标优化整合到共享的、与后端无关的引擎中，使预测器特定代码只需一个轻量的预处理适配器和去噪循环中的一个钩子。距离、角度和二面角约束、相对于参考结构的偏差约束、用户定义的反应坐标约束以及配体构象约束，均可用统一配置格式指定。该工具包目前支持六种预测器，包括 AlphaFold3。在全部六种预测器上，构象约束消除了预测配体中的 chirality 和 cis/trans 错误并改善其局部几何；几何约束和自定义约束则系统地将采样的蛋白质构象推向指定目标状态。因此，RGI-Toolkit 提供了一个统一框架，用于将实验信息和先验几何知识整合进结构预测，并生成具有指定构象和立体化学性质的生物分子结构。
items.author_line: Hori, T., Moriwaki, Y., Ishitani, R.

items.title: RePurpose: An LLM-Assisted, Source-Traceable Drug Repurposing Tool with Retrospective Validation on Clemastine in Multiple Sclerosis
items.abstract_or_text: Summary: Thus far, evidence for drug repurposing is contained in target-, drug-, trial-, and literature-based data sources that are challenging to synthesize for non-specialists. Here, we introduce RePurpose, a web-based tool that takes as input a topic written in plain language and returns candidate drugs built from data in Open Targets, ClinicalTrials.gov, UniProt, and PubMed. For queries in the form of a goal, RePurpose filters candidate drugs by whether they modulate all targets implicated in the goal in the corresponding direction. Every candidate has a source that contributes evidence: a structured database, a clinical trial, or a proposal from a large language model. An adjustable ranking adjusts the order of candidates from well-studied to less well-known candidate drugs. We retrospectively tested RePurpose with the trial drug clemastine, which was being considered as a remyelinating agent in multiple sclerosis (MS). RePurpose retrieved clemastine in each replicate of the mechanism-worded queries, but in no replicates of the disease-worded queries, and no structured query retrieved it without the language model enabled. Its ranked outputs reflected the evidence supporting clemastine but not later evidence of harm in progressive MS, which was reachable only through an on-demand literature search. Our results imply that RePurpose may be better at tracing evidence around a hypothesis than generating new hypotheses. Availability and Implementation RePurpose Pharma is freely accessible at https://www.repurposepharma.com/. For code and more information on the application, see: https://github.com/nayagamnitin-hub/RePurpose-Pharma.
items.summary_zh: RePurpose是一个可追溯来源的LLM辅助药物再利用工具，并以多发性硬化中的clemastine进行回顾性验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工具把多源证据连接到候选药物，但案例显示其更适合追踪既有假设，不能替代主动的安全性文献检索。
items.abstract_zh: 迄今为止，药物再利用的证据分散在靶点、药物、试验和文献数据源中，非专业人士很难综合这些信息。我们介绍RePurpose，这是一个基于网页的工具，输入用自然语言书写的主题后，利用Open Targets、ClinicalTrials.gov、UniProt和PubMed中的数据返回候选药物。对于目标形式的查询，RePurpose会根据候选药物是否以相应方向调节该目标所涉及的全部靶点来进行筛选。每个候选药物都有一个提供证据的来源：结构化数据库、临床试验或大型语言模型提出的建议。可调节的排序功能会将候选药物从研究充分到研究较少进行排列。我们使用曾被考虑作为多发性硬化症（MS）再髓鞘化药物的试验药物clemastine，对RePurpose进行了回顾性测试。在机制措辞的查询中，RePurpose在每次重复实验中都检索到clemastine，但在疾病措辞的查询中一次也没有检索到；如果不启用语言模型，结构化查询也无法检索到它。其排序结果反映了支持clemastine的证据，但没有反映进行性MS中后来出现的危害证据；这些证据只能通过按需文献检索获得。我们的结果表明，RePurpose可能更适合围绕一个假设追踪证据，而不是生成新的假设。RePurpose Pharma可免费访问于https://www.repurposepharma.com/。应用的代码和更多信息见：https://github.com/nayagamnitin-hub/RePurpose-Pharma。
items.author_line: Nayagam N, Arun A

items.title: Entropy-driven adaptive neural architecture search for cell segmentation on edge devices
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Accurate and real-time segmentation of cells in microscopy images is a critical task in biomedical research. Incubator-like edge devices are increasingly being used for real-time monitoring of cellular activities, facilitating timely intervention, which is particularly important when studying dynamic cellular processes. However, adapting to the deployment requirements of diverse edge devices, particularly those with limited resources, presents significant challenges in network architecture design. This requires considering resource constraints and hardware metrics associated with different edge devices, necessitating rigorous control of model complexity and resource utilisation. To address these challenges, we propose a hardware-aware neural architecture search method based on the U-Net backbone to segment various cell types. By incorporating hardware-based penalty terms and an entropy-driven mechanism, our method optimizes the search strategy to maximize segmentation accuracy while ensuring compatibility with target hardware. We evaluated our approach on five resource-constrained hardware platforms and achieved competitive segmentation performance on ten 2D live-cell imaging datasets from the Cell Tracking Challenge, while maintaining favourable hardware efficiency.
items.summary_zh: 提出熵驱动、硬件感知的神经架构搜索，用于资源受限边缘设备上的细胞图像分割。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在5种硬件平台和Cell Tracking Challenge的10个二维活细胞数据集上评估，兼顾分割性能与部署效率。
items.abstract_zh: 准确且实时地分割细胞显微图像是生物医学研究中的关键任务。类似培养箱的边缘设备正越来越多地用于实时监测细胞活动，这对研究动态细胞过程尤其重要，因为它可以及时干预。然而，要适应不同边缘设备的部署要求，特别是在资源有限的设备上设计网络架构，仍然面临重大挑战。这需要考虑不同边缘设备的资源限制和硬件指标，并严格控制模型复杂度和资源利用率。为应对这些挑战，我们提出一种以U-Net为骨干的硬件感知神经架构搜索方法，用于分割不同细胞类型。通过引入基于硬件的惩罚项和熵驱动机制，我们的方法优化搜索策略，在确保与目标硬件兼容的同时最大化分割准确率。我们在5个资源受限的硬件平台上评估该方法，并在Cell Tracking Challenge的10个二维活细胞成像数据集上取得具有竞争力的分割性能，同时保持良好的硬件效率。
items.author_line: Xu Y, Khan TM, Zhu Y, Song Y, Meijering E

items.title: Evolutionarily Conserved Plasmodium falciparum HSP70-3 Enhances the Immunogenicity of the Established Malaria Vaccine Antigen Circumsporozoite Protein through Cross-Presentation
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Clinically approved P. falciparum circumsporozoite protein (PfCSP)-based pre-erythrocytic stage malaria vaccines suffer from sub-optimal efficacy and rapidly waning memory. By decoding these limitations, we fast-tracked vaccine optimization by correcting CSPs fragile immunogenicity using a parasite-derived chaperone. Unlike other orthologues of P. falciparum heat shock protein 70 (PfHSP70), substrate-binding domain (SBD) of PfHSP70-3 is an evolutionarily conserved internal mitochondrial matrix chaperone. We demonstrate that PfHSP70-3-SBD hydrophobic region complexes with PfCSP and targets host CD91 on antigen-presenting cells to trigger cross-presentation, resulting in enhanced immune responses to PfCSP. Methods: In silico analyses predicted interactions among PfHSP70-3-SBD, PfCSP, and CD91 receptor. Recombinant PfHSP70-3-SBD and PfCSP proteins were purified and assessed for in vitro interaction using ELISA and far-western dot blot assays. BALB/c mice were immunized with alum-formulated PfCSP, with or without PfHSP70-3-SBD. PfCSP-specific IgG and IFN-{gamma} expression were evaluated by ELISA and RT-qPCR, respectively. Functional activity was assessed using transgenic Plasmodium berghei expressing PfCSP (Pb/Pf CSP), by sporozoite neutralization assay. Findings: PfHSP70-3-SBD demonstrated a specific interaction with PfCSP. The complex primarily engages CD91 receptor cluster IV, providing a potential mechanistic basis for antigen cross-presentation. Incorporation of PfHSP70-3-SBD enhanced PfCSP-specific total IgG responses and increased IFN-gamma expression in BALB/c mice, indicating improved immunogenicity upon co-formulation. Notably, immune sera neutralized Pb/Pf CSP sporozoites, delaying blood-stage patency until day 12 in 40% of C57BL/6 mice, with no detectable parasitemia in surviving mice for up to 2 months, indicating sustained efficacy against the sporozoite stage. Interpretation: Molecular chaperones, including HSPs, are currently under intense investigation for their immune-potentiating activity, leading to next-generation vaccine development. By utilizing chaperonic domains derived directly from the pathogenic agent itself to serve an essential adjuvant function, this approach reduces reliance on heterologous adjuvants while enhancing antigen-specific immunity. Funding: This work was supported by funding from Indian Council of Medical Research (IIRPSG-2024-01-03940). Keywords: Substrate-binding domain, PfHSP70-3, Adjuvant, Cross-presentation, Pre-erythrocytic stage, Plasmodium falciparum
items.summary_zh: 以寄生虫来源的PfHSP70-3-SBD增强PfCSP交叉呈递，在小鼠中提高疟疾疫苗免疫原性并延迟感染。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结合计算预测、蛋白互作实验、免疫学检测和转基因寄生虫挑战，提供了从机制到动物验证的证据链。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：临床批准的、基于P. falciparum环子孢子蛋白（PfCSP）的红细胞前期疟疾疫苗存在疗效不足和记忆快速衰减的问题。为了解决这些局限，我们通过寄生虫来源的伴侣蛋白来纠正CSP脆弱的免疫原性，从而加速疫苗优化。与P. falciparum热休克蛋白70（PfHSP70）的其他直系同源蛋白不同，PfHSP70-3的底物结合结构域（SBD）是一种进化保守的线粒体基质内伴侣蛋白。我们证明，PfHSP70-3-SBD的疏水区域与PfCSP形成复合物，并靶向抗原呈递细胞上的CD91，以触发交叉呈递，从而增强针对PfCSP的免疫反应。方法：计算机分析预测了PfHSP70-3-SBD、PfCSP和CD91受体之间的相互作用。重组PfHSP70-3-SBD和PfCSP蛋白经纯化后，使用ELISA和远端蛋白质印迹实验评估体外相互作用。BALB/c小鼠接受含明矾佐剂的PfCSP免疫，或接受加入PfHSP70-3-SBD的相同免疫。通过ELISA和RT-qPCR分别评估PfCSP特异性IgG和IFN-γ表达。使用表达PfCSP的转基因Plasmodium berghei（Pb/Pf CSP）通过子孢子中和实验评估功能活性。结果：PfHSP70-3-SBD与PfCSP发生特异性相互作用。该复合物主要结合CD91受体簇IV，为抗原交叉呈递提供了潜在的机制基础。加入PfHSP70-3-SBD增强了PfCSP特异性总IgG反应，并提高了BALB/c小鼠中的IFN-γ表达，表明共同配方能够改善免疫原性。值得注意的是，免疫血清能够中和Pb/Pf CSP子孢子，使40%的C57BL/6小鼠血液期感染出现推迟至第12天；存活小鼠在最长2个月内均未检测到寄生虫血症，表明其对子孢子期具有持续效力。解读：包括HSP在内的分子伴侣目前正受到广泛研究，因为它们具有增强免疫的活性，可用于开发下一代疫苗。利用直接来源于病原体的伴侣结构域发挥关键佐剂作用，可以减少对异源佐剂的依赖，同时增强抗原特异性免疫。经费：本研究由Indian Council of Medical Research（IIRPSG-2024-01-03940）资助。关键词：底物结合结构域，PfHSP70-3，佐剂，交叉呈递，红细胞前期，Plasmodium falciparum。
items.author_line: Garg, P., Verma, C. K., Gupta, K., Sharma, A., Jawla, S., Jha, N., Saini, S., Kumar, K. A., Ranganathan, A., Singh, S.

items.title: Discovering state-of-the-art quantum circuits with large language models
items.abstract_or_text: Significant efforts are currently being directed toward the implementation of large-scale quantum information processors, but realizing useful quantum advantage also requires the development of efficient quantum algorithms. While for many practical problems the dominant resource costs are associated with a small set of computational primitives, optimizing them in the quantum setting presents unique challenges, including a reversibility constraint absent from ordinary classical computation. Here we introduce an evolutionary framework in which large language models (LLMs) propose circuit designs and an independent evaluator verifies and scores them. We apply this framework to tasks spanning numerical computation, chemistry, optimization, quantum simulation, and number theory. In seven of the eight tasks, the discovered circuits significantly reduce both Toffoli and qubit counts relative to the state of the art. In the eighth, the search discovers a new reversible architecture for prime-field modular inversion. By handling reversibility differently, the architecture makes divsteps -- a classical algorithm previously impractical for reversible integer arithmetic -- viable and substantially improves the Toffoli-qubit trade-off for modular inversion. These results open the door for evaluator-guided LLM co-design of new algorithmic structures for quantum computation.
items.summary_zh: 该研究让大语言模型提出量子线路、由独立评估器验证和评分，并在数值计算、化学、优化、量子模拟和数论任务上进行进化搜索；八项任务中有七项同时降低了 Toffoli 和 qubit 数量。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 评估器引导的 LLM 线路共设计在包含化学任务的多类问题上发现了低资源线路，并为可逆算法给出新的 prime-field modular inversion 架构，展示了 AI 辅助量子化学计算基础设施的潜力。摘要未提供化学子任务的独立实验结果或各任务资源明细，结论主要依据线路资源指标。
items.abstract_zh: 当前正投入大量努力实现大规模量子信息处理器，但要获得有用的量子优势，还需要开发高效的量子算法。对于许多实际问题，主要资源成本集中在少数计算原语上；然而，在量子环境中优化这些原语面临独特挑战，包括普通经典计算没有的可逆性约束。这里，我们引入一种进化框架，由大语言模型（LLM）提出线路设计，再由独立评估器验证并评分。我们将该框架应用于涵盖数值计算、化学、优化、量子模拟和数论的任务。在八项任务中的七项中，发现的线路相对于当前最佳水平显著减少了 Toffoli 和 qubit 数量。在第八项任务中，搜索发现了一种用于 prime-field modular inversion 的新型可逆架构。通过以不同方式处理可逆性，该架构使 divsteps——一种此前对可逆整数算术不切实际的经典算法——变得可行，并显著改善了 modular inversion 的 Toffoli-qubit 权衡。这些结果为评估器引导的 LLM 共同设计量子计算新算法结构打开了道路。
items.author_line: Andi Gu, Alek H. Kemeny, Susanne F. Yelin, Mikhail D. Lukin

items.title: Calibration, Uncertainty, and Data Efficiency of Deep Learning Chest Radiograph Classifiers Under Cross-Dataset Distribution Shift: A Multi-Dataset Benchmark
items.abstract_or_text: Purpose To evaluate the external transportability of source-derived probability calibration for chest radiograph deep learning classifiers under distribution shift and determine its dependence on sample size and disease prevalence. Materials and Methods This retrospective secondary computational analysis of public, de-identified radiographic datasets involved no participant contact or new data collection. Cohort sizes were prespecified by availability without prospective power calculation: 106,686 NIH ChestX-ray14 images (29,323 patients; 1992-2015) for development and internal testing, 20,000 CheXpert images (20,000 patients; October 2002-July 2017), and 14,998 VinBigData images (2018-2020) for external testing. ResNet-18, DenseNet-121, and DeiT-Tiny classifiers for cardiomegaly and pleural effusion were trained across four patient fractions and three seeds (36 fits). Calibrators were fitted exclusively on NIH data. Twelve primary external Brier-score contrasts (temperature-scaled versus raw probabilities) were evaluated using paired cluster-bootstrapping with Holm adjustment. Results Temperature scaling reduced Brier scores in nine of 12 primary contrasts but worsened pleural effusion calibration on VinBigData across all architectures (Brier increases: ResNet-18, 0.001460 [95% CI: 0.001347, 0.001568]; DenseNet-121, 0.001193 [95% CI: 0.001109, 0.001274]; DeiT-Tiny, 0.000498 [95% CI: 0.000417, 0.000577]; all adjusted P=.006). Standardizing class weights to NIH prevalence reversed all CheXpert improvements. Although full versus 10% training improved external AUROC across all comparisons, DeiT-Tiny CheXpert pleural effusion Brier score worsened by 0.007039 despite a 0.032466 AUROC gain. At 80% selective image retention, calibrated ensembles retained only 12.3%-17.2% of VinBigData positive pleural effusion examinations. Conclusion Source-fitted calibration is not uniformly transportable across health systems, and discrimination gains do not guarantee calibrated probabilities. External evaluation must simultaneously assess probability reliability, prevalence shifts, and retained-case composition.
items.summary_zh: 在131,684张多数据集胸片上评估深度学习分类器在分布偏移下的校准、外部可迁移性和数据效率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果显示区分度提升不等于概率可靠性提升，强调临床模型必须同时评估外部校准、患病率变化和筛选样本构成。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：评估源数据拟合的概率校准在分布偏移下对胸部X线深度学习分类器的外部可迁移性，并确定其对样本量和疾病患病率的依赖。材料与方法：这项回顾性二次计算分析使用了公开、去标识化的影像数据集，不涉及参与者接触或新的数据采集。队列规模由数据可得性预先确定，未进行前瞻性效能计算：用于开发和内部测试的NIH ChestX-ray14包含106,686张图像（29,323名患者，1992-2015年）；外部测试使用20,000张CheXpert图像（20,000名患者，2002年10月-2017年7月）和14,998张VinBigData图像（2018-2020年）。针对心脏增大和胸腔积液，训练了ResNet-18、DenseNet-121和DeiT-Tiny分类器，覆盖4种患者数据比例和3个随机种子（36次拟合）。校准器仅在NIH数据上拟合。采用配对聚类bootstrap并进行Holm校正，评估12个预先指定的外部Brier分数对比（温度缩放与原始概率）。结果：在12个主要对比中，温度缩放有9个降低了Brier分数，但在VinBigData的胸腔积液校准中对所有架构均造成恶化（Brier增加：ResNet-18为0.001460［95% CI：0.001347，0.001568］；DenseNet-121为0.001193［95% CI：0.001109，0.001274］；DeiT-Tiny为0.000498［95% CI：0.000417，0.000577］；调整后P=.006）。将类别权重标准化到NIH患病率后，CheXpert上的所有改善均被逆转。尽管从10%训练量增加到完整训练量在所有比较中都提高了外部AUROC，但DeiT-Tiny在CheXpert胸腔积液任务中的Brier分数恶化了0.007039，尽管AUROC提高了0.032466。在保留80%图像进行选择性预测时，经过校准的集成模型在VinBigData阳性胸腔积液检查中仅保留12.3%-17.2%。结论：源数据拟合的校准并不能在不同卫生系统之间稳定迁移，区分度提升也不保证校准概率可靠。外部评估必须同时考察概率可靠性、患病率偏移和保留病例的构成。
items.author_line: Shamim, F., Hussain, R. A.

items.title: Diagnostic accuracy of deep learning for microsatellite instability prediction in gastric cancer: A systematic review and meta-analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Deep learning (DL) applied to haematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-stained pathology images can predict microsatellite instability (MSI) in gastric cancer (GC). We evaluated its diagnostic accuracy and discriminative performance. PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library and Web of Science were searched for studies applying DL to H&E images for MSI prediction in GC. The protocol was prospectively registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261503140). Risk of bias was assessed with QUADAS-2. Pooled sensitivity and specificity were estimated with a bivariate random-effects model, with subgroup analyses by validation strategy and data source; slide-level areas under the curve (AUCs) were pooled after logit transformation. Prespecified scenario analyses assessed robustness. Ten studies were included; seven independent datasets from six studies entered the primary synthesis. Pooled sensitivity, specificity and summary receiver operating characteristic AUC were 0.78 (95% CI 0.63-0.88), 0.85 (95% CI 0.77-0.90) and 0.89 (95% CI 0.86-0.91); nine studies contributed to the secondary AUC synthesis (pooled AUC 0.85, 95% CI 0.80-0.89). Hospital-derived cohorts showed numerically higher sensitivity (0.86) and diagnostic odds ratio (39.8) than TCGA-derived cohorts (0.71 and 11.5), but subgroup differences were limited by the small number of studies and substantial heterogeneity. DL models show good diagnostic accuracy for MSI prediction in GC, but clinical utility still requires confirmation in standardised multicentre, independent external and prospective studies.
items.summary_zh: 系统综述和Meta分析汇总深度学习从胃癌H&E病理图像预测微卫星不稳定性的诊断准确性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 纳入10项研究和7个独立数据集，显示总体诊断性能良好，但临床应用仍需标准化、多中心、独立外部和前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 应用于苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色病理图像的深度学习（DL）可以预测胃癌（GC）中的微卫星不稳定性（MSI）。我们评估了其诊断准确性和区分性能。我们检索了PubMed、Embase、Cochrane Library和Web of Science中使用H&E图像预测GC中MSI的研究。研究方案已在PROSPERO中前瞻性注册（CRD420261503140）。使用QUADAS-2评估偏倚风险。采用双变量随机效应模型估计合并敏感度和特异度；根据验证策略和数据来源进行亚组分析；在logit转换后合并切片级曲线下面积（AUC）。预先指定的情景分析评估结果的稳健性。共纳入10项研究；其中6项研究的7个独立数据集进入主要综合分析。合并敏感度、特异度和汇总受试者工作特征AUC分别为0.78（95% CI 0.63-0.88）、0.85（95% CI 0.77-0.90）和0.89（95% CI 0.86-0.91）；9项研究贡献了次要AUC综合分析（合并AUC 0.85，95% CI 0.80-0.89）。医院来源队列的敏感度（0.86）和诊断优势比（39.8）在数值上高于TCGA来源队列（分别为0.71和11.5），但由于研究数量少且异质性显著，亚组差异受到限制。DL模型在GC的MSI预测中显示出良好诊断准确性，但其临床效用仍需在标准化、多中心、独立外部和前瞻性研究中确认。
items.author_line: Du, Y., Liao, H., Li, J., He, Y., Di, J.

items.title: QREF: Improving DeepSearch Agents by Aligning Search with Reasoning via Query Refinement and Evidence Filtering
items.abstract_or_text: DeepSearch agents achieve strong performance on complex information-seeking tasks through iterative search and reasoning. However, they often issue intent-misaligned, under-constrained, or redundant search queries, resulting in poor evidence coverage and accumulating retrieval noise. To mitigate these limitations, we propose QREF, a plug-and-play Query Refiner and Evidence Filter. Specifically, the Query Refiner rewrites search queries according to the current reasoning intent while ensuring complementary coverage across each search batch. The Evidence Filter retains evidence relevant to both the current search batch and the reasoning objective, reducing distracting retrieval results. We initialize the Query Refiner with supervised fine-tuning and optimize it through reinforcement learning based on interactions with a real-world web search environment, reducing ineffective queries. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our approach improves the performance of DeepSearch agents across four challenging benchmarks, achieving average relative Pass@1 improvements of 33.55% on WebSailor and 11.04% on TongyiDeepResearch without modifying architectures or retraining their reasoning policies. Compared with the original DeepSearch backbone without QREF, the RL-trained refiner reduces the fraction of query batches that lack discriminative retrieval anchors by 95%. Compared with the SFT-trained refiner, it also lowers the filter-based ineffective query ratio.
items.summary_zh: 提出 QREF，通过查询改写和证据过滤使 DeepSearch 代理的搜索更贴合当前推理意图，并在四个基准上报告 Pass@1 提升及无效查询比例下降。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把搜索、证据覆盖和推理目标联系为可测的代理任务，既有 RL 与 SFT 对照，也给出跨基准结果；摘要未展开各任务的绝对分数和误差范围。
items.abstract_zh: DeepSearch 代理通过迭代搜索和推理，在复杂信息检索任务上取得了较强表现。然而，它们经常提出与意图不匹配、约束不足或冗余的搜索查询，导致证据覆盖不足并积累检索噪声。为缓解这些问题，我们提出即插即用的查询改写器和证据过滤器 QREF。具体而言，查询改写器根据当前推理意图重写搜索查询，同时确保每个搜索批次之间具有互补覆盖；证据过滤器保留同时与当前搜索批次和推理目标相关的证据，减少干扰性检索结果。我们使用监督微调初始化查询改写器，并根据其与真实网络搜索环境交互的结果，通过强化学习进行优化，以减少无效查询。在四个具有挑战性的基准上的综合实验表明，该方法无需修改架构或重新训练推理策略，就能提升 DeepSearch 代理的性能：在 WebSailor 上 Pass@1 平均相对提升 33.55%，在 TongyiDeepResearch 上提升 11.04%。与未使用 QREF 的原始 DeepSearch 主干相比，经过 RL 训练的改写器使缺少判别性检索锚点的查询批次比例降低了 95%。与经过 SFT 训练的改写器相比，它还降低了基于过滤器判定的无效查询比例。
items.author_line: Yujia Chen, Yuhui Wang, Junzhe Wang, Shihan Dou, Di Liang, Yujiong Shen, Yuhao Zhou, Zhiheng Xi, Ming Zhang, Senjie Jin, Jiayi Chen, Dingwei Zhu, Yajie Yang, Yuan Hua, Chenyao Lu, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang

items.title: Librarian Agents: Training LLMs to Curate Long-Context Workspaces that Anticipate Future Queries
items.abstract_or_text: Reasoning over long document contexts remains a challenge for large language models (LLMs). Standard retrieval methods are inherently reactive, bottlenecking agents with complex, cross-document reasoning at inference time, while precomputed structures like knowledge graphs often fall short because they rely on rigid heuristics. Instead, can we allow agents to perform anticipatory directed curation: learning to proactively reorganize unstructured corpora prior to inference to efficiently serve diverse future queries. We build on a key asymmetry in modern agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code): while LLM agents are adept at navigating existing filesystems to solve an immediate task, they are rarely trained to construct reusable workspaces for future use. To instantiate this capability, we introduce Librarian Agents, a framework in which a builder agent transforms raw documents into a hierarchical filesystem of synthetic files and reference links, which forms a workspace tailored for a downstream answering agent. We formulate workspace construction as a Markov decision process and optimize the builder policy via reinforcement learning to directly maximize downstream answering accuracy. Empirically, Librarian Agents outperforms the strongest retrieval and precomputation baselines by 33 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus, amortizes upfront construction costs across repeated queries, and generalizes zero-shot to unseen domains on BRIGHT with a 31-point average accuracy improvement.
items.summary_zh: 提出 Librarian Agents，把原始文档主动整理为带层级文件和引用链接的工作区，并把工作区构建建模为 MDP，通过下游回答准确率进行 RL 优化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 构建动作、下游目标和跨域测试都较明确，报告了 BrowseComp-Plus 与 BRIGHT 上的显著提升；指标依赖下游回答代理，不能直接解释为数学推理提升。
items.abstract_zh: 在长文档上下文中进行推理仍然是大语言模型（LLM）面临的挑战。标准检索方法本质上是反应式的，使复杂的跨文档推理在推理时受到瓶颈限制；而预先计算的结构（如知识图谱）往往也不理想，因为它们依赖僵化的启发式方法。我们能否让代理在推理前主动重组非结构化语料，以高效服务多种未来查询？我们基于现代代理式工具环境（例如 Claude Code）中的一种关键不对称性构建方法：LLM 代理擅长导航现有文件系统来解决眼前任务，却很少接受训练去构建可复用、面向未来的工作区。为实现这种能力，我们提出 Librarian Agents 框架：构建代理把原始文档转换为由合成文件和引用链接组成的层级文件系统，形成供下游回答代理使用的定制工作区。我们将工作区构建形式化为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），并通过直接最大化下游回答准确率来优化构建策略。经验结果表明，Librarian Agents 在 BrowseComp-Plus 上比最强的检索和预计算基线高 33 个百分点；在重复查询中，它能够摊销前期构建成本；在 BRIGHT 上零样本泛化到未见领域时，平均准确率提高 31 个百分点。
items.author_line: Anikait Singh, Teresa Zhang, Yoonho Lee, Roshen Sanjay Nair, Aviral Kumar, Chelsea Finn

items.title: CoWorld Reasoner: Agentic Multimodal Reasoning with the Evolving Video World Model-Driven Harness
items.abstract_or_text: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) advance, they are increasingly expected to perform spatiotemporal reasoning over motion, actions, and view changes beyond what the input images show. Video World Models (VWMs) provide a natural unified engine for visual imagination by generating task-relevant visual content as additional evidence. However, existing approaches typically invoke a VWM through fixed pipelines centered on a predefined form of visual imagination, such as novel-view synthesis. To support flexible visual imagination for diverse reasoning tasks, we introduce CoWorld Reasoner, an agentic framework that uses a VWM as a unified visual reasoning engine. Its Video World Model-Driven Harness exposes multiple visual operations through tools and uses skills to guide the VLM in deciding whether to imagine, selecting an operation, constructing a generation request, and interpreting the resulting visual evidence. We further introduce VLM-VWM Harness Co-Evolution, which jointly revises tools, skills, and execution code based on execution feedback while keeping both model weights fixed. Across seven benchmarks spanning spatial intelligence, temporal and causal reasoning, and perceptual reasoning, CoWorld Reasoner outperforms direct reasoning with the same VLM. The strongest variant improves on all seven benchmarks, including relative accuracy gains of 11.8% on MMSI and 13.0% on ERQA, and outperforms all five evolving baselines using the same backbone across five benchmarks.
items.summary_zh: 提出 CoWorld Reasoner，将视频世界模型作为视觉推理引擎，通过工具和技能让 VLM 决定何时想象、采用何种操作及如何解读视觉证据，并在七个基准上比较。

items.abstract_zh: 随着视觉语言模型（VLM）不断发展，人们越来越希望它们能够对运动、动作和视角变化进行时空推理，而不仅仅依赖输入图像所显示的内容。视频世界模型（VWM）通过生成与任务相关的视觉内容作为额外证据，为视觉想象提供了自然的统一引擎。然而，现有方法通常通过以预定义的视觉想象形式（例如新视角合成）为中心的固定流程调用 VWM。为支持多种推理任务所需的灵活视觉想象，我们提出 CoWorld Reasoner，这是一种将 VWM 用作统一视觉推理引擎的代理式框架。其视频世界模型驱动的工具环境提供多种视觉操作，并使用技能引导 VLM 决定是否进行想象、选择哪种操作、构造生成请求以及解读由此得到的视觉证据。我们进一步提出 VLM-VWM Harness Co-Evolution：在保持模型权重不变的同时，根据执行反馈共同修改工具、技能和执行代码。在涵盖空间智能、时间与因果推理以及感知推理的七个基准上，CoWorld Reasoner 优于使用相同 VLM 的直接推理。最强变体在全部七个基准上都有提升，其中包括 MMSI 上 11.8% 的相对准确率增益和 ERQA 上 13.0% 的相对准确率增益；在五个基准上，它还优于使用相同主干的全部五种演化基线。
